description: JACK is a web-based e-assessment and automated tutoring system developed and operated at the University of Duisburg-Essen for authoring, delivering, automatically evaluating, and providing feedback on exercises.
title: JACK e-assessment system

description: A personality-based questionnaire developed at Queensland University that classifies learners into five styles for use in learner modelling and adaptive content and presentation selection.
title: Jackson's learning styles profiler

description: A paragraph-writing assessment scale that rates content, organization, grammar, vocabulary, and mechanics across four performance bands, developed by Jacobs, Zinkgraf, Wormuth, Hartfiel, and Hughey and later modified by Hedgcock and Lefkowitz.
title: Jacobs et al. (1981) paragraph rating scale modified by Hedgcock and Lefkowitz (1991)

description: A Joint Advisory Group (JAG) framework that specifies diagnostic EUS competencies, staged case-volume training, assessment requirements, certification, and postcertification mentorship for advanced endoscopy trainees.
title: JAG four-domain framework for EUS training and certification

description: A 20-situation written discourse-completion assessment developed by Jalilifar for measuring learners' production and awareness of request speech acts.
title: Jalilifar's 20-situation Discourse Completion Test for request speech act awareness

description: A twelve-element framework developed by Janssen et al.
title: Janssen et al.'s twelve-element digital competence model

description: A Japanese translation and validation of the UK SPRAT multisource feedback instrument, developed for assessing Japanese doctors' clinical, teaching, communication, teamwork, and professionalism competencies.
title: Japanese version of the Sheffield Peer Review Assessment Tool (SPRAT)

description: The Jasper Woodbury Problem Solving Series is a set of anchored-instruction video adventures and open-ended mathematics problem-solving materials developed by the Cognition and Technology Group at Vanderbilt for upper-elementary and middle-school learners.
title: Jasper Woodbury Problem Solving Series

description: Jastudy is a computer-assisted language-learning program developed by Liu et al.
title: Jastudy

description: A Boris Ruf prototype plugin that adds an on-demand clarification button beneath YouTube lecture videos and retrieves pre-produced explanations for selected timestamps.
title: JavaScript prototype plugin integrating the Huh? button with YouTube videos
